notes: Ethereum mainnet deployment of InkPortraits, InkVault, InkLiquidity and InkRenderer in the listed order. Every owner argument and the NFT royalty recipient resolve to $owner. InkVault uses the specified seats NFT. InkLiquidity uses the official Uniswap v4 Ethereum PoolManager and PositionManager listed at https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/protocols/v4/deployments; its treasury receives IMD fees only and has no owner role. InkFeeRouter is deployed separately by the owner. InkHook and src/testnet contracts are excluded. This manifest includes no token or pool deployment, ETH funding or initialization calls.
